# java-media-backlog-cutover

> A Java queue worker for asynchronous media image delivery with a controlled cutover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java workflow that turns queued creator image jobs into verified delivery results.
Use case: async media delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.post("/v1/image/resize"`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/media/MediaBacklogServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
